title: What the Brussels summit could mean for the Brexit deal
description: BBC political editor Chris Mason looks at the potential agreements between the UK and EU that could be reached on food, energy and youth mobility.

title: Secret UK cyber operation protected tens of thousands of fridges from hackers
description: Supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants and stadiums have been scrambling to make their devices safe.

title: Massive hope for pancreatic cancer pill after trial saw tumours vanish
description: Daily pill daraxonrasib appears to shrink and possibly even eliminate tumours in some patients with one of the deadliest cancers.

title: Calls for consent law change after Joanne Young rape case
description: Joanne Young's daughter joins her mother in calling for a change to the law on consent.

title: Mouldy, infested housing for vulnerable people sold as ethical investments abroad
description: The properties are marketed at premium prices with claims of “government-backed” returns, the BBC finds.

title: UK braces for coldest night of autumn so far with temperature of -10C forecast
description: Friday night is expected to be the coldest of the autumn so far with temperatures dropping as low as minus 10C, as Simon King explains.

title: Three Kyiv bridges hit during major Russian missile attack
description: Five people were killed in a wave of strikes which follow Ukraine's successful targeting of the Crimean Bridge.

title: Next round of BBC cuts will be more noticeable to audiences, report warns
description: The BBC has already cut jobs, programmes and services but has further to go to reach its £500m target.

title: Guests no longer asked to wash up as new Airbnb rules come into force
description: New rules on what Airbnb hosts can reasonably ask guests to do could mean fewer chores but higher costs for customers.
